assessments.measurement: An actual local console remains healthy after its UI HTTP client disconnects; the packaged macOS applicationWillTerminate path explicitly terminates the child runtime.
alreadyEstablished: Automation, Telegram, collectors, managed process wake, restart recovery exist
closing only the browser UI does not define canonical work loss
missing: UI and runtime product lifecycle are not explicitly separated
app termination ends the child runtime
sleep, wake, update, and login-start ownership are not one qualified product journey
assessments.firstCountertest: close UI, retain one runtime owner, then restart and recover exact pending work without duplicate channel or effect

assessments.measurement: A deterministic 500-page PDF is locally bounded to the first 20 pages with 480 omitted, so the whole document is not supplied by default; a purpose sentinel on page 421 is not found, proving purpose-selective late-page recall is still missing.
alreadyEstablished: A2 Information Control, ContextReceipt, RecordRef, memory pointers, CH3 and terminal output recall exist
missing: actual serialized provider request has no user-facing transmission category receipt
not-sent scope cannot yet be reported as exact or unknown
assessments.firstCountertest: fixed large document purpose with exact answer and source oracle, measuring serialized provider categories and coverage

alreadyEstablished: GitHub CLI broker, terminal credential broker, Connection Truth, Notion and Remote MCP boundaries exist
missing: registered authenticated CLI coverage is narrow
local sync folder, OS capability, local CLI and remote connection do not share one user-purpose handoff
unregistered credential reuse remains unavailable by design
assessments.firstCountertest: one already-authenticated registered CLI completes a real read purpose without credential exposure or re-login

alreadyEstablished: Memory portable export, app activity export, append-only ledgers and artifact identities exist
missing: no stable snapshot across Conversation, Work, Memory, Automation, History, Artifact and Capability
no isolated relationship-verified restore and activation
assessments.firstCountertest: restartable mixed-state fixture cannot be moved to a fresh isolated HOME with secret-free exact continuity

alreadyEstablished: multiple model adapters, manual model switching and canonical model-change receipt exist
missing: no automatic admission to an allowed fallback on transport failure
partial stream finalization boundary is absent
post-tool fallback exact non-reexecution is unqualified
assessments.firstCountertest: primary fails after one local tool effect and fallback finishes from canonical state with tool executions unchanged

alreadyEstablished: memory, connection, activity, Work, Effect and Artifact surfaces exist
missing: no whole backup and restore surface
delete scope does not yet summarize local, backup and external copies together
assessments.firstCountertest: a nontechnical user identifies local state, provider transmission, external copies and backup coverage without internal terms

next: Open Alpha1 by freezing resident-runtime ownership, lifecycle, update, sleep/wake and notification incident families before product wiring.
